title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.71 (versions follow prime numbers; 571 after 569): she converses. A book of everyday customs is on her shelf (what is said and what is answered). When someone speaks to her she gathers up to seven examples from her books and gives them to her school's song (memoria_pares, as it was), which learns what follows what where two examples say it; what she adds is her own rule of the hole: two words standing in the same hole are of one kind, and a kind is one letter for the song. An example that says exactly what was said to her is the memory of it; a word the song sings must be said by two examples; with no rule she says the nearest memory. Measured in a hidden copy with her real ways: six phrases of six answered in one second each; in those runs what she answered were memories of her book, not compositions. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
